name: adriana
description: Single-page site for Adriana, explicadora in Porto (Paranhos)

scripts.start: npm run build && python3 -m http.server -d dist
scripts.check: npm run check:contact && npm run check:html && npm run check:a11y
scripts.check:a11y: python3 -m http.server 8080 -d dist & SRV=$!; sleep 2; npx --yes pa11y-ci --config .pa11yci.json; RC=$?; kill $SRV; exit $RC
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check
